nodes.title: Note
widgets_values:
## 1 · Your image
Upload one image of a single object or character. **Square works best** (1:1), any background: BiRefNet cuts it out.

nodes.title: Note
widgets_values:
## 3 · Pick the model
**true = TRELLIS.2** (default), **false = Pixal3D**.

TRELLIS.2 is the all-rounder; Pixal3D follows the camera of the image more closely.

nodes.title: Note
widgets_values:
## 4 · Coarse 3D model
TRELLIS.2 / Pixal3D build the shape at 1024. The coarse mesh is saved to `output/hi3d/coarse` for a before/after.

nodes.title: Note
widgets_values:
## 5 · Remesh twice
AeroX's fix: cleans stair-steps and broken thin parts (ears) before Hi3D. Without it, they carry into the detailed mesh.

nodes.title: Note
widgets_values:
## 6 · Hi3D
6-8 GB: **int8**. 12 GB+: fp16 also works.

Nodes and weights by AeroX (github.com/Aero-Ex).

nodes.title: Note
widgets_values:
## 7 · Results
`output/hi3d/refined_512`, `_1024`, `_1536`.
1536 has 8-17M faces: decimate it for games.
